decisions.reason: After two years without being observed on the website, this otherwise core cardboard display likely failed to justify dedicated attention relative to aspiration levels, so resources should be returned to the main range and new development.

Despite fitting established capabilities, the pegboard-backed variant appears not to have sustained enough demand or visibility to meet aspirations, making withdrawal the likely boundedly rational choice.

This close-to-core quarter-pallet display would normally be protected by organizational slack, but two years of non-observation suggest persistent underperformance or redundancy within a narrow product portfolio.
The eighth-pallet format serves a narrower use case and, with no visible market presence for two years, is likely judged below aspiration and better discontinued.

As the least central product to the firm's cardboard-focused routines, the wooden display pallet is the clearest candidate for exit once results remain uncertain and attention shifts back to core strengths.
Its specialized media focus and two-year absence from the observable offer indicate it likely did not meet aspiration levels, so management would probably redeploy the resources elsewhere.
